sehemu: Part II: Members of Parliament, Constituencies and Election of Members
jina: Procedure for nomination of candidates for election of women Members
maudhui: Without prejudice to the other provisions of this Constitution, the Electoral Commission may prescribe provisions specifying the procedure to be used by political parties for selecting and proposing the names of Members of Parliament of the category referred to in Article 66(1)(b).
